source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Verify the location, dates, and times of suspected incidents.
3. Confirm the equipment used for measurement is calibrated and in good working order.
4. Collect data on wind speed, direction, temperature, and humidity at the time of emissions.
5. Review emission regulations pertaining to the specific industry and establish a benchmark for acceptable emissions levels.
6. Document all high levels of pollutants such as SOx, NOx, CO, particulate matter, VOCs, and other specific gaseous pollutants.
7. Measure the concentration of pollutants in the air at varying distances from the source.
8. Compare recorded emission levels with regulatory limits and note any exceedances.
9. Record visual observations of any visible emissions like smoke or odors.
10. Include photographs or videos of observed emissions, if possible.
11. Detail any operational changes, maintenance activities, or process upsets that might have contributed to excessive emissions.
